description:
> *This was generated by AI during research for docs/research/elixir-compilers-and-idioms.md.*

`Defk.__before_compile__` sets `@on_load :__defk_load__` (lib/defk.ex L409 at 16b4b06). A user module that already has its own `@on_load` fails with Elixir's `ArgumentError` "the @on_load attribute can only be set once per module", raised from `Module.put_attribute/7` with `Defk.__before_compile__/1` on the stack. There is no defk diagnostic, and the `Defk` moduledoc doesn't mention the restriction.

Reproduced 2026-10-12 (Elixir 1.20.2): `use Defk`, `@on_load :init`, `def init, do: :ok`, one `defk` kernel.

Options: a defk compile error that names the conflict and says how to chain (call `__defk_load__/0` from the user's hook), a moduledoc line, or chaining automatically. See the note's meta-programming audit ("use instead of import" row).
title: Defk's @on_load clashes with a user module's own @on_load: raw ArgumentError, no defk diagnostic
